_about: One place for the operator's public details (DECISIONS.md D141). Read by site/build.mjs (every page's footer, the Contact section, the Meta tag), the app (mobile/src/constants/site-config.ts), the Edge Functions (supabase/functions/_shared/site-config.ts) and the engine's user agent (engine/src/remitbridge_engine/config.py). Change a value here and each picks it up on its next build, deploy or run. CONTACT_EMAIL is hello@remitbridgelabs.org, forwarded to the RemitBridge Gmail by ImprovMX and sent from Gmail through Resend (2026-10-03). INCORPORATED is true: Washington's Secretary of State accepted the Articles, and Angad has the certificate (2026-10-08; Meta lists the business as REMITBRIDGE LABS). MAILING_ADDRESS stays empty by Angad's choice (2026-10-03): the Contact sections ask people to email for it instead. Other empty strings render nothing. Never a home address.
